# Round Colour Designs

> Round Colour Designs is a founder-led interior design and turnkey execution studio based in Mulund West, Mumbai.

## Core facts
- Brand: Round Colour Designs
- Tagline: Shaping Dreams
- Founded: 2022
- Founders: Akshay Vanare and Pratibha Vanare
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98339 92725
- Address: 31, Saidham Shopping Plaza, Mulund West, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Service area: Mulund, nearby areas, Mumbai Metropolitan Region, and selected projects across Maharashtra
- Consultation: Complimentary introductory consultation; meetings by prior appointment
- Pricing: Project-specific and provided after consultation; no standard starting price is published

## Founder expertise
- Akshay Vanare: Co-Founder & Head of Design Execution; Diploma in Interior Designing; 10+ years of industry experience
- Pratibha Vanare: Co-Founder & Head of Kitchen Design & Client Experience; Diploma in Interior Designing; 5+ years of industry experience

## Services
- Residential interior design
- Commercial and office interiors
- Restaurant, cafe and hospitality interiors
- Bungalow and villa interiors
- Farmhouse interiors
- Interior consultation and space planning
- 2D layouts, working drawings and 3D visualisation
- Modular kitchens, wardrobes and storage solutions
- Custom furniture, lighting, ceiling and electrical planning
- Civil renovation, turnkey execution and site supervision
- Styling, decor, material selection and project management
- Architectural and structural coordination through qualified professionals where required
